name: Noronex Limited
summary: Noronex Limited engages in the mineral exploration in Australia, Namibia, and Canada. It primarily explores for uranium and copper deposits. The company's flagship project is the Witvlei Copper project in Namibia. The company was formerly known as Lustrum Minerals Limited and changed its name to Noronex Limited in November 2020. Noronex Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
